detaileddescription.para: We keep track of the status of context so that we do not make API calls at an inappropriate time, such as synchronizing twice.

briefdescription.para: This is the underlying context implementation common to all types.

detaileddescription.para: We use this class rather than the front-end ones (stream_ctx, graph_ctx, ...) in the internal methods where we don't always know types for example.
